---
title: "04 — Raw product QC"
format: html
---

## Goal

Audit each acquired environmental family before any harmonization or derivation.

## Minimum checks

- file readability and metadata consistency;
- variable names, units, dimensions, CRS/grid;
- returned spatial extent versus request;
- temporal coverage and gaps;
- native resolution;
- fill values / NoData / masks;
- physically plausible value ranges;
- daily or native-time coverage maps;
- missingness through time and across space;
- source-version consistency.

## Decision

Every variable family receives `GO`, `REVIEW`, or `STOP`. No downstream processing is allowed from a `STOP` source artifact.
